source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1119 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 1119.

PD 1119.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1119 was established by Ordinance No. 32906, passed by the Dallas City Council on October 23, 2024. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1119 is established on property located at Gallagher Street and Ingersoll Street, north of Nomas Street and west of Iroquois Street. The size of PD 1119 is approximately 44.611 acres. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Creation Of Subareas
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.104. CREATION OF SUBAREAS.

This district is divided into three subareas: Subarea A, Subarea B, and Subarea C. These subareas are shown on the conceptual plan (Exhibit 1119A) and described in the property descriptions (Exhibit 1119B). If there is a conflict between the boundaries shown on the conceptual plan and the boundaries described in the property description, the property description controls. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.105. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 1119A: conceptual plan.

(2) Exhibit 1119B: property descriptions. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.106. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan. If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the conceptual plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.107. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For handicapped group dwelling unit and single family uses, a preliminary plat may serve as the development plan. If there is a conflict between the text of this article and a final plat, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, a development plan must be approved by the city plan commission before the issuance of any building permit to authorize work in this district. If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.108. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The following uses are the only main uses permitted:

(1) Agricultural uses.

-- Crop production.

(2) Institutional and community service uses.

-- Church. -- Community service center. [SUP] -- Open enrollment charter school. [SUP] -- Public school. [SUP]

(3) Miscellaneous uses.

-- Carnival or circus (temporary). [By special authorization of the building official.] -- Temporary construction or sales office.

(4) Recreation uses.

-- Private recreation center, club, or area. [SUP] -- Public park, playground, or golf course.

(5) Residential uses.

-- Handicapped group dwelling unit. [SUP required if spacing component of Section 51A-4.209(b)(3.1) is not met.] -- Single family.

(6) Transportation uses.

-- Transit passenger shelter.

(7) Utility and public service uses. . -- Electrical substation. [SUP] -- Local utilities. [SUP or RAR may be required. See Section 51A-4.212(4)] -- Utility or government installation other than listed. [SUP] (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.109. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.110. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Subareas A and B.

(1) Front yard. Minimum front yard is 20 feet.

(A) Driveways and pavements within a required front yard may only be a maximum width of 18 feet.

(B) Additional impervious pavement within the required front yard is limited to sidewalks.

(2) Side and rear yard.

(A) Except as provided in this paragraph, minimum side and rear yard is 10 feet. Minimum side and rear yard is five feet for single family structures.

(B) The provisions for contiguous block face setback do not apply to these subareas.

(3) Density. Maximum dwelling unit density is six units per acre.

(4) Floor area ratio. No maximum floor area ratio.

(5) Height.

(A) Maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(B) The following structures may project a maximum of five feet above the maximum height:

(i) Chimneys or vent stacks.

(ii) Skylights.

(6) Lot coverage.

(A) For residential structures, maximum lot coverage is 60 percent.
(B) For non-residential structures, maximum lot coverage is 25 percent.
(C) Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not

(7) Lot size. Minimum lot size is 4,000 square feet.

(8) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two.

(b) Subarea C.

(1) Front yard. Minimum front yard is 20 feet.

(A) Driveways and pavements within a required front yard may only be a maximum width of 18 feet.

(B) Additional impervious pavement within the required front yard is limited to sidewalks.

(2) Side and rear yard.

(A) In general. Except as provided in this paragraph, minimum side and rear yard is 10 feet.

(B) Single family structures.

(i) No minimum rear setback is required.

(ii) A minimum five foot setback is required on one side of the lot. No minimum setback required on the other side of the same lot.

(C) The provisions for contiguous block face setback provisions do not apply to this subarea.

(3) Density. Maximum dwelling unit density is nine units per acre.

(4) Floor area ratio. No maximum floor area ratio.

(5) Height.

(A) Maximum structure height is 30 feet.

(B) The following structures may project a maximum of five feet above the maximum height:

(i) Chimneys or vent stacks.

(ii) Skylights.

(6) Lot coverage.

(A) For residential structures, maximum lot coverage is 60 percent.

(B) For non-residential structures, maximum lot coverage is 25 percent.

(C) Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(7) Lot size. Minimum lot size is be 2,000 square feet.

(8) Lot width. Minimum lot width is 24 feet.

(9) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.111. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.112. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.113. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Tree mitigation is not required for Class 3 trees.

(c) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Sidewalks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.114. SIDEWALKS.

A sidewalk with a minimum unobstructed width of five feet must be provided along all street frontages. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Open Space
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.115. OPEN SPACE.

(a) A minimum of 20 percent of the Property must be maintained as open space and may be completed in phases.

(b) A minimum area of 90,000 square feet of contiguous open space must be provided upon the completion of all phases

(c) A maximum of 55 percent of open space areas may include detention areas or flood zones.

(d) Open space may include pedestrian amenities and trails. These amenities may include, but are not limited to, benches, playground equipment, shade structures, pedestrian lighting, fountains, swimming pools, amenity center, dog parks, pedestrian paths, or bike racks.

(1) In Subareas A and C, a minimum of two amenities must be provided in each of the subarea’s designated open space areas.

(2) In subarea B, a minimum of five amenities must be provided in the subarea’s designated open space area.

(e) Private balconies, sidewalks, parking spaces, parking lots, drive aisles, and areas primarily intended for vehicular use are not considered open space and do not count towards the open space requirement.

(f) Operation or parking of vehicles within on-site open space is prohibited. Emergency and grounds maintenance vehicles are exempt.

(g) Open spaces must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance, and plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.116. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Right-Of-Way
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.117. RIGHT-OF-WAY.

Right-of-way must be constructed as shown on the conceptual plan or preliminary plat. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.118. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) Roofs. For single-family structures, flat roofs and roof decks are prohibited.

(b) Maintenance. The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(c) Compliance. Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 32906)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1119.119. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 32906)
